reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper so every existing weekend-handling path (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) picks up the daily rule through it.

duplication.why: The rule itself is defined once; schedule-template's two identical inline ternaries are folded into a local getAdjustedDate, and only the 'take more occurrences then drop nulls' pattern recurs at two callers.

placement.why: The weekend rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, with parseRecurDate carrying frequency into the schedule data where the shared code reads it.

scope.why: Only the weekend helper, its callers, the schedule data and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: One definition with a clear null contract for skipped days; the null-aware loop in schedule-template and the fixed count*7 window are slightly awkward but readable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend-handling call sites go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: No reshaped copies; the duplicated schedule-template ternaries were consolidated.

one_place.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts returns null for daily weekend occurrences, and getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts all call it with the schedule frequency.
